/--
`LawfulIdentity op o` indicates `o` is a verified left and right
identity of `op`.
-/
class LawfulIdentity (op : α → α → α) (o : outParam α) : Prop extends Identity op o, LawfulLeftIdentity op o, LawfulRightIdentity op o
